Pay Stub - 2026-05-19

Summary
- Adds pay stub generation and a printable pay stub page for payroll run employees.

What's new
- New `PayStubService` constructs pay stub models for payroll run employees.
- New `PayStub.razor` page shows company, employee name, masked SSN, pay period, pay date, earnings, taxes, deductions, net pay, and direct deposit last 4.
- Print-friendly layout with a Print button.

Testing
- Unit tests added in `PayStubServiceTests` for pay stub data generation and missing record handling.

Security
- Only SSN last 4 and bank account last 4 are displayed.
- Full SSNs and full bank account numbers are never shown.

Notes
- Year-to-date totals are currently placeholders.
